title: Docs: gateway OS hardening guide
description: Write docs/gateway-hardening.md covering: (1) minimal OS (Alpine/NixOS/Buildroot instead of Raspbian), (2) read-only root filesystem (dm-verity or squashfs), (3) disable SSH (serial console only for production), (4) unprivileged gateway binary with seccomp, (5) automatic security updates for the minimal OS. Not a code change — operator guidance. Reference from AGENTS.md and spec/appendix-border-router.md.
